hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; out=$( { cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build -j8 && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure; } 2>&1 ) && exit 0; { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E 'CMake Error|error:|\*\*\*Failed|\*\*\*Timeout|Failure|exception|actual:|Which is|tests passed' || printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -20; } | head -40 >&2; exit 2

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+-rf|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+--force|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|DROP[[:space:]]+TABLE' && { echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
